question: Why can parents not view Subjects (404) in UntisX (endpoint /rooms)?
answer: Check role parents. Module Subjects may require higher permissions. Error 404: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /rooms and the database connection. Feature Sorting must be enabled.
